metadata.title: Drone Maker Ondas Updates Its Profitability Forecast as Revenue Surges 1,558%<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Drone Maker Ondas Updates Its Profitability Forecast as Revenue Surges 1,558%
Fresh off announcing a new private artificial-intelligence company in partnership with Palantir Technologies, autonomous drone maker Ondas posted record quarterly revenue and forecast it can break even sooner than expected.
